items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire/aim in that direction and change facing; movement and firing can combine in one action; 'wait' delays; pointer can hover UI/minimap.

MECHANICS (observed): Contact with enemies, projectiles, or green burst clouds damages the player; HUD shows red hearts with hollow outlines when lost, plus counters for coins/keys/bombs. Minimap at top-right shows room layout with current room highlighted. Rocks/barrels/chests block tears. Ordinary poop is destructible by tears (destroyed with debris, no drop seen). Pedestal items are collected by touching: one gave a transient golden sprite tint; one granted 'TECH X — Laser ring tears' (head-slot passive). TECH X changes the attack to radial ring/laser bursts expanding in all directions that destroy poop and can kill enemies; visuals are brief red ring bursts/markers, so screenshots often miss projectiles. Poop near the same spot appeared again after destruction (respawn vs. second pile unclear). TNT barrels and a bomb sprite were inert to tears (earlier run); a lit bomb did not self-detonate ~2s.

ENEMY BEHAVIOR (observed): Gray winged flies; tanky fat red-eyed enemies flash red near death then switch to skull-face enraged form; blue orbs/droplets chase; fast blue spiders; cup-shaped and blue-goo spawners emit orbs; fire-skull; hooded blobs; blue-eyed skull carving in a wall (hazard unconfirmed); a green blob appeared then dissipated harmlessly. White-faced round enemies (seen this attempt in a wave room) spawn inside rock rings/bursts, are protected while shelled, emerge exposed, show smoke puffs when hit, become enraged (dark open-mouth/red face) and emit green orbs; on death they burst into a damaging green cloud. They respawn repeatedly with no end observed. One died quickly to a ring laser; others took many hits.

ROOM/DOOR RULES (hypothesis, not confirmed): doors often fail to transition until enemies are cleared; transitions require near-exact alignment with the door center (repeatedly observed: off-center presses fail, centered ones work); centered doors may still need repeated presses. Green burst clouds damage on contact — do not linger in them.

NAVIGATION (observed this attempt): Tutorial room (wall diagrams for move/attack/bomb/item) has a top door, a bottom door, and a dark right-wall panel with red dot markings. Bottom door leads to a brazier room (four corner braziers, central rock cluster with poop, golden gate at bottom center). Brazier room's top alcove returns to the tutorial; its bottom golden gate leads to an item room (pedestal with TECH X). That item room's top gold-trimmed door returns to the brazier room. Tutorial's top door leads to a rock/wave room: many rocks, a gold keyhole door on the left wall, plus top and bottom doors. Earlier run (same layout uncertain): tutorial top -> rock room with gold-locked left door; further rooms included a TNT room (barrels, locked chests, inert bomb), a rock room with fat enemies, and a wave room with blue orb/spider spawners, gilded poop, and a wall skull carving.

FAILED STRATEGIES: fighting fat enemies at point-blank/contact range cost hearts; firing through central rocks wasted shots; waiting on the inert bomb did nothing; attempting doors/hatches while wave enemies were alive failed (top door, bottom door, left keyhole door); pressing into the gold keyhole door many times while perfectly aligned and holding keys did not unlock it; the tutorial's right-wall panel did not open under repeated alignment/right presses; standing in or walking into green bursts drained hearts fast.

UNRESOLVED: whether doors unlock only on full room clear (the wave room never appeared clearable); whether the wave room can be cleared or exited at all; whether the gold keyhole door ever opens; whether green orbs damage or can be absorbed (one seemed to lodge in the sprite with no immediate heart loss); whether the right-wall panel is a functional/locked door; meanings of minimap icons (skull, gold, red item are guesses); whether the wall skull carving fires hazards; whether gilded poop is destructible and drops items; whether a pedestal pickup caused a key counter increase (uncertain); why the player sprite sometimes shows a TV/monitor-like or white-faced appearance (item effect vs. damage state — uncertain).
